rule: Expected margin is generated before kickoff at the intended prediction cutoff.
evidence_needed: prediction cutoff + kickoff + expectation snapshot lineage

rule: Expectation model training cutoff precedes the target prediction cutoff.
Target canonical game and all mirrored representations are excluded from expectation-model training/evaluation fold.
Future games/results after the historical cutoff cannot train the expectation model for that target game.
Primary BAS expectation anchor is BAS-independent and does not consume BAS labels/targets.
Primary scientific anchor does not use an A&M-underperformance target that would absorb the effect being tested.
Exact expectation-model family is not selected in W15; W16/W17 compare eligible families under this contract.
evidence_needed: W16 model registry + W17 protected evidence

rule: Every label stores expectation model/version/fold/cutoff/data snapshot provenance.
Changing expectation anchor/version creates a new BAS label version; historical labels are not overwritten.
Sensitivity anchors such as market or selected forecast variants remain separate analyses and cannot silently replace the primary label.
